newsitem.title: UK: Belfast adds flights with winter timetable.
newsitem.headline: Belfast adds flights with winter timetable.

text.p: Belfast International airport has added through flights to Southampton for the first time with its winter timetable which started Sunday October 27.
British Airways Express is now running a daily flight to Southampton aimed to link up various domestic services via Manchester.
Cargo ex-Belfast is carried in the belly of planes and a spokesman said electronic goods are an important exports item.
The busiest route is from Belfast to Heathrow with a total of 14 daily Boeing 737s flown by British Airways and British Midland Airways.

Aer Lingus flies to New York via Shannon three times a week from Belfast and airport marketing manager Uel Hoey said this "has been a big success particularly in attracting passengers from the United States direct to Northern Ireland." -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
